verdict.line: You lose the lane if you walk into Bear Trap and Jousting range before level 6 and get poked down for free; you win it once Skaarl's bar breaks and you burst Kled before he can remount.

brief.thesis: This matchup is built around Skaarl's separate health bar. While mounted, Kled pokes from 800 range with Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) and repositions with 550-range E (Jousting), both well outside Garen's 300-range Q and 325-range E, which is why the data gives him the early solo-kill edge. The moment Skaarl's bar empties, Kled dismounts, deals less damage to champions, and loses Bear Trap entirely (replaced by the self-knockback Pocket Pistol), so Garen's shorter cooldowns and all-in burst swing the fight back to the measured 51.7% in his favor.

theirWindow.when: Kled mounted with Q and E up
theirWindow.what: He can land Bear Trap (800 range, 11-7s CD) or dash in with Jousting (550 range, 13-9s CD) and reset out, chipping you from range you can't answer. Don't feed him free pokes — hold W (Courage) and wait for him to spend one of these before you close.

yourWindow.when: Skaarl's bar hits zero, Kled dismounts
yourWindow.what: Dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions and trades Bear Trap for Pocket Pistol, a knockback that pushes himself away rather than hooking you. Chain Q (Decisive Strike) silence into E (Judgment) and W (Courage) immediately — he has no gap-close left if you commit now.

powerCurve.note: Neither side has a dangerous cooldown rotation yet
Jousting dash combo and Violent Tendencies punish melee trades
R unlocks but save it for his dismount
Judgment's 9s cooldown outpaces his sustained pressure
Full build and Conqueror close out extended duels

start.why: The lane's defensive shape and Kled's ranged mounted poke reward the flat damage reduction and sustain over raw damage early.

boots.why: Attack speed accelerates your Q-silence-into-auto burst and helps you keep pace when he tries to kite with Jousting resets.

core.why: The active gives you the gap-close you're missing against his 550-range dash, letting you close before he can reset courage.
Attack speed and slow resistance keep you attached through his Jousting dashes and Violent Tendencies windows.
Grievous wounds shuts down any healing he gets back from courage restoration once you've committed to the all-in.

situational.when: he keeps disengaging with jousting resets and you need more sustained chase speed
you're already ahead and want to shorten the time it takes to execute through his mounted HP pool
you need an extra burst of mobility to catch him before he remounts

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking damage and healing reward you for staying in extended skirmishes, which is exactly the fight you're trying to force once Skaarl's bar is low.

summoners.why: Ignite punishes the all-in the moment Skaarl dismounts, securing the kill before Kled can regenerate courage through fighting or escape with a Jousting reset.

playing.title: Don't walk into his cooldowns
playing.detail: If Bear Trap (800 range) and Jousting (550 range) are both up, stay out of range rather than trading — wait for him to spend one first.

playing.title: Burst Skaarl, not Kled
playing.detail: W (Courage) and E (Judgment) damage hits Skaarl's bar the same as Kled's — rotate both to force the dismount rather than poking at his own HP.

playing.title: Save R for after dismount
playing.detail: Mounted Kled has far more effective HP and keeps an escape tool. Only commit Demacian Justice once Skaarl's bar is empty.

playing.title: Punish the Jousting recast window
playing.detail: After his first E dash, he either recasts to dash back through you or is stuck on cooldown — that's your moment to close with Q's silence.

playing.title: Silence his escape, not his engage
playing.detail: Decisive Strike's silence is most valuable stopping Pocket Pistol's knockback or a Bear Trap re-throw once he's trying to disengage dismounted.

playing.title: Finish fast once he's low
playing.detail: Kled restores courage by fighting, so a prolonged trade with his mount near empty risks him stabilizing — commit your burst in one rotation instead of poking it out.

playing.title: Play safe for XP before 6
playing.detail: The data shows Kled holds the early solo-kill edge — don't overextend for CS while his Jousting-into-Bear Trap combo is live.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, and win rates come from measured Garen vs Kled games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning — poke windows, dismount timing, and cooldown tracking — is my own read, not part of OP.GG's data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Kled’s (Q) when fighting him. Close in to deal damage whenever your skills come off cooldown. After reaching level 6, use your ultimate only after he dismounts Skaal.
